[SWS_DM_01226] Support of UDS service authentication
⌈
If configured,
the Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the UDS service 0x29 Authenti-
cation with the subfunctions.
• deAuthenticate • verifyCertificateUnidirectional
• verifyCertificateBidirectional
• proofOfOwnership
• transmitCertificate
• authenticationConfiguration
according to ISO 14229-1:2020 [2].
⌋
